correctness.rationale: For a strictly interior homogeneous binary first-order Markov spatial chain, the only strings giving R3=0 and R3=2 are 000 and 101. Thus A=t(1-a)^2, B=(1-t)ba, C=t(1-a)^3 (the sole R4=0 string is 0000). Direct algebra gives a=1-C/A, t=A^3/C^2, b=BAC^2/((C^2-A^3)(A-C)) and necessary/sufficient strict feasibility 0<C<A, A^3<C^2, 0<B<(C^2-A^3)(A-C)/(AC^2). Reconstructed stationarity ta=(1-t)b iff BC^2=A(A-C)^2. For the stationary model u=sqrt(A),v=sqrt(B), the full R3 law identifies t=(u+v)^2, a=v/(u+v), b=v(u+v)/(1-(u+v)^2), with (u+v)(u+2v)<1. Two distinct stationary chains yield the same R2 distribution, proving the sharp minimum observed window length three. The transfer-matrix z-marks of 0-to-1 transitions and initial occupancy prove all-n PGFs. Independent exact rational binary-string enumeration for multiple parameters and n<=7 verified inverse, stationarity, and PGF identities, not used as infinite-n proof.
